en: Editable inputs are mapped through the template parameter schema and preset to its existing animation project.
The declared timeline has a fixed duration; new content fits its existing scene order and timing.
zh: 通过模板参数和预设，将本期文字、数据或素材映射到已有动画工程。
已声明时间轴为固定时长，本期内容按现有场景顺序和节奏适配。

title.zh: 多屏拼贴 · 品牌宣传

summary.en: Introduce a brand or creative tool with screen collages, editorial transitions and a branded ending.
summary.zh: 用多屏拼贴、版面切换和品牌收尾展示产品与创作流程，适合品牌介绍和工具宣传。

subtitle.zh: 多屏拼贴 · 品牌宣传

materials.en: The current brand name, logo and applicable feature icons.
materials.zh: 本期品牌名称、Logo，以及实际需要的功能图标。

materials.en: Your topic, script and facts to preserve.
materials.zh: 本期主题、文稿与需要准确保留的信息。

materials.en: Current product screenshots, screen recordings and display materials for the declared media slots.
materials.zh: 声明素材槽位对应的本期产品截图、录屏与展示内容。

materials.en: A licensed music track or your preference for music in this production.
materials.zh: 本期已授权配乐，或本期是否需要配乐的偏好。

materials.en: The current voice recording or your narration preference for this production.
materials.zh: 本期配音文件，或是否需要配音的安排。

dependencies.en: The package declares a Python and Node.js host. Check its dependency lock for supported versions and any additional rendering tools.
dependencies.zh: 模板声明使用 Python 和 Node.js。具体工具与版本以下载包为准。

dependencies.en: Use the package dependency lock and setup/check instructions. Check existing tools first, install only missing requirements and verify a preview.
dependencies.zh: 按下载包的依赖锁和 setup/check 说明检查已有工具，只补齐缺项，并验证预览。

en: Fixed57s landscape product film using current copy, brand artwork, graph labels and supplied image/video carriers. Preserve source scene order, motion and independent SFX.
zh: Fixed57s landscape product film using current copy, brand artwork, graph labels and supplied image/video carriers. Preserve source scene order, motion and independent SFX.

en: The documented output is 1920 × 1080, 60 fps. The public demo is 57 seconds.
Use the actual package parameter bounds; extra materials do not automatically create extra scenes.
Changing scene order, output duration or engine; these are not parameters of this fixed native arrangement.
Declaring arbitrary copy length or every product topic suitable without actual layout and semantic review.
zh: 已声明输出为 1920 × 1080，60 fps；公开样片 57 秒。
按实际包的参数边界制作；增加素材不会自动增加场景。

capabilities.en: Optional services require a live catalog, template slot and account check before they can be confirmed.
capabilities.zh: 配套服务需核对官网实时能力、模板槽位和账号权限后才能确认。
